notes: Fiscal year alignment: historical years are Deckers’ fiscal years ended March 31 (FY2023=ended Mar 31, 2023; FY2024=ended Mar 31, 2024; FY2025=ended Mar 31, 2025). Historical revenue/EBIT/D&A/capex from FY2025 and FY2024 Form 10-K statements. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))

EBIT in the historical section is proxied as “Income from operations.” D&A is proxied as “Depreciation, amortization, and accretion” from the cash flow reconciliation. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))

NWC construction: modeled as (Total current assets − cash and cash equivalents) − Total current liabilities (i.e., excludes cash; assumes no separate short-term investments line item). This is a modeling choice; actual “NWC” may differ under alternative definitions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))

Tax rate is set to 0.23 based on management’s FY2026 effective tax rate guidance; long-run WACC is an analyst assumption (not disclosed in the filings) to support DCF. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

NOLs: Deckers discloses NOL-related amounts within deferred tax assets, but no clear standalone NOL balance and utilization schedule suitable for this DCF input spec was found in the available sections; therefore nol_balance and nol_utilization_pct are set to null. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))
Current price uses the tool-reported DECK price; “as_of_date” is set to 2026-03-21.

catalysts: Further upward revisions to FY2026 and/or FY2027 demand and margin outlook driven by UGG/HOKA sell-through and pricing actions. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Tariff/trade-policy outcomes that affect cost and inventory flow timing (both directions) could move operating margins. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Sustained buyback pace (already very large in FY2026 YTD) could amplify per-share value even if total enterprise value changes slower. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))
company_overview: Deckers is a global designer, marketer, and distributor of footwear, apparel, and accessories, with brands including UGG and HOKA. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052126000002/deckex991pressrelease-1231.htm))

Revenue is generated across wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels with meaningful international exposure. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))

The company operates with a strong cash position and no outstanding borrowings under revolving credit facilities at recent reporting dates. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))
current_context: As of Jan 29, 2026, management raised its full fiscal 2026 net sales outlook to $5.400 billion to $5.425 billion (mid-teens HOKA growth; mid-single-digit UGG growth). ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Full-year operating margin is guided to approximately 22.5% with an effective tax rate of approximately 23%. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Q3 FY2026 results showed operating income of $614.4 million and net sales up to $1.958 billion year over year. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Balance sheet strength: cash and cash equivalents were $2.087 billion at Dec 31, 2025 and the company reported no outstanding borrowings. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base case chains from FY2025 revenue growth into a moderate deceleration path consistent with maturity after strong brand momentum. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))

EBIT margin is set near the FY2026 operating margin guide (~22.5%) and then modestly stabilizes, reflecting continued pricing power and operating leverage. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Capital intensity is modeled with a higher FY2026 capex/sales profile aligned to recent company expectations, then gradually normalizes. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))

Working capital is normalized toward a lower, more stable level (NWC excluding cash), consistent with the company’s recent cash-flow profile and inventory management. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))
Terminal value is anchored using a Gordon growth framework with conservative long-run growth assumptions.
key_risks: Demand softness, especially if discretionary spending weakens or competitors pressure pricing and promotions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))

Margin compression from higher input costs (tariffs/logistics), mix shifts, or reduced pricing power. ([ir.deckers.com](https://ir.deckers.com/news-events/press-releases/press-release/2026/Deckers-Brands-Reports-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx))
Working-capital and inventory risk (forecast error leading to slower cash conversion). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052125000017/deck-20250331.htm))
